_meta.description: Market reference prices for buying Brazilian points and miles (R$ per 1,000). The user's own average purchase cost lives in data/my-balances.json (avg_cost_per_milheiro_brl) and always takes precedence. Use these numbers to answer 'is this purchase promo good?' and to compute the effective cost of airline miles after a transfer bonus.

formula: effective_cost_per_airline_milheiro = purchase_cost_per_milheiro / (base_ratio * (1 + bonus_pct/100)). Example: Livelo at R$ 25.33 with +100% to Smiles at 1:1 = 25.33 / 2 = R$ 12.67 per 1,000 Smiles miles.

livelo.note: Floor seen in strong promos (MilhasBot, Sep 2026). Regular reference from Mai.app 2026.

esfera.note: Floor per MilhasBot Sep 2026. User already bought at R$ 28.85, below this reference.

decision_rules: A buy + transfer is worth it only if the effective airline milheiro is below what that program's miles will be redeemed at (see brl_milheiro in data/points-valuations.json) AND there is a concrete redemption in sight.
Never transfer Livelo/Esfera without a transfer bonus unless an award is about to disappear; bonuses of 80-100% to Smiles/LATAM/Azul are routine.
Points bought for a specific trip: check that the transfer arrives in time (Livelo up to 7 business days).
